question: I have a question!! If Chopper has such a splendid blue nose that he can tell where his crewmates are at any time, what do all the members of the Straw Hat Crew smell like? Does Luffy have a rubbery smell?? Let's ask Chopper.
answer: Yes, yes. There's a 3 on it. I combined all these questions into one. Each one's number, color and smell (according to Chopper). [Luffy: *01 *56 'Rubber' (5=Go - 6=mu) *[Red] *Smells like Meat · Sanji: *05 *32 'Sanji' (3=San - 2=ji) *59 'Cook' (5=Ko - 9=kku) *[Blue] *Smells like Cigarettes and Seafood  ||  Zoro: *02 *[Green] *Smells like Steel · Chopper: *06 *[Pink] *How Should I Know?  ||  Nami: *03 *73 'Nami' (7=Na - 3=mi) *[Orange] *Smells like Oranges (and Money) · Robin: *07 *[Purple] *Smells like Flowers  ||  Usopp: *04 *[Yellow] *Smells like Gunpowder]
name: Budomaru
